title: •Information Exchange
caption: •Information Exchange (V)
game_text: Deploy on Imperial City. While your {set:reflections2} objective on table, Scum And Villainy may deploy here and, if a Black Sun agent present, may not be canceled. During your deploy phase, may ▼ a non-weapon card with “Black Sun” or “Xizor” in lore.
lore: “Chisa nyooda ishaley. Kun Jabba neguda len malta.” “Ikkit ui! Yobbit, yobbit. Nelan tui ke bada.”

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box → grabber false. Inline icon in 'While your [icon] objective on table': a small purple disc with a toothed grey rim — matched by eye against the Feb 2024 Game Aid (Reflections II set icon = purple toothed disc; the Objective type icon is a black disc with a white star) and assets/icons/set-reflections2-grainy.png → {set:reflections2}. The wiki stub reads it as '[Objective]' — stub differs; please double-check this icon. The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly double quotes around “Black Sun” and “Xizor” (stub straight). Lore corrected from scan: opening curly quote added before 'Chisa' and the stray straight quotes replaced with curly “…” (wiki: 'Chisa … Malta.' 'Ikkit …'), 'malta' lower-case as printed (wiki 'Malta'), 'yobbit.' (wiki typo 'yobbiy.'). Base scan 350 px only; copyright line legible: 1998 Hoth-style line (Jabba's Palace). Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
